_about: Item categories for the daily ratings mail and dashboard. Decided with Pranjay on 6 Nov 2026.
These are FORMAT categories for reading ratings (a tub rates differently from a pastry),
so they are finer than the spine item_glossary's product categories. Occasions (Rakhi,
Diwali, Valentine, Christmas) are never a category here, per the 28 Aug 2026 decision.
Lookup order: 'overrides' by exact (normalised) name, then 'rules' top to bottom on the
lowercased name, then 'Uncategorised', which is listed at the foot of the mail, never guessed.
To move one item: add it to 'overrides'. To catch a new range: add a rule in the right place.
A single-product gift box or combo takes its product's category (Pranjay's alias convention);
only mixed hampers, bonbon and mithai boxes are Hampers.

rules.note: a cheesecake in any format (slice, jar, tub, whole) stays a cheesecake
the packaged Snacks range: a biscuit-type name sold by pack weight or piece count
fresh cookies and brownies, incl. the cookie tins and the Boss Biscuit
dessert tubs and jars; jar cakes are jars by format
half kilo and 1 kg cakes, tea cakes, plum cakes, cupcakes and cake bouquets
sits after Cakes and Cookies so a Tiramisu Cake is a cake and a Kunafa Cookie is a cookie; sits before Add-ons so Kunafa & Teddy is a dessert
